source_evidence: Player exact 'The line is mortal dignity. That it.' establishes V's articulated principle in fictional defense consultation; do not infer additional V policy choices. Elara supports principle and independently articulates safeguards, general acknowledges premise but poses real emergency evacuation dilemma, councillor asks V's view; no enacted decision or automatic unanimity. No contested check, new resource expenditure or additional quest assignment. D316~14:30 Caereth palace defense consultation. V and Elara present as invited speakers with security councillor, advisers, Assembly delegates and general. In response to question about limits on emergency authority, V states exact 'The line is mortal dignity. That it.' Elara independently endorses principle and suggests practical safeguards: emergency powers limited to actual necessity, no coerced experimentation or arbitrary detention, accountable officers and preservation of lawful civilian rights. General accepts that soldiers serve mortals rather than own them but raises concrete unresolved dilemma of evacuating civilians who refuse to leave an imminently threatened district. Councillor acknowledges distinction between protective necessity and treating people as expendable; asks V whether he would permit narrowly necessary temporary compulsory evacuation under immediate threat with protection and return rights, or draw line at voluntary evacuation. No policy, formal vote, new House undertaking or player answer established. V accepts earlier confidential diplomatic invitation carriage to Orsaven, letter/credentials pending preparation. Elara standing political representative; Severin assent pending. Crown intelligence commission active remaining300+1300 contingent, Kestrel evidence custody unchanged.
